agent_note: Complete, 40/40 quotes. Past-tense third person with a first-person retrospective strand (q02679, q02687, q02692, q02700, q02706, q02715). Only present-tense event quote is q02706, the first-person narrator's discourse-now, which points to a frame/letter structure rather than simultaneous narration — not enough evidence to call it dual. Heavy aphorism load (11 gnomic of 40), consistent with the source's quotability bias. Three past-tense generalizations flagged in notes: q02686 kept gnomic (real-world citation, no story-world referent), q02696 and q02710 kept event/past (backshifted reported thought).
